summary: Requested the decisive probe for the candidate membership defect. The harness first builds a realistic two-node ordered configuration containing the local node, then applies RemoveNode for node 9, an identity absent from the configuration, and finally attempts AddNode for node 9. Each event records acceptance, entry index, member/observer/witness counts and whether node 9 is recorded as removed, so the next turn can tell whether a non-member removal is accepted and whether it permanently blocks adding that identity. Successor experiment records the changed harness and rationale; no conclusion before the receipt.
